name: o57642
description:
Dear Team,

After reviewing the latest performance data from the O3D3xx sensor, I’ve updated the temporal exponential filter settings to better balance responsiveness and noise suppression. The minimum smooth‑difference threshold is now set to **0.45**, and the corresponding minimum SD‑alpha coefficient has been adjusted to **0.27**. On the upper end, the maximum smooth‑difference allowed is **0.92**, with a maximum SD‑alpha value of **0.88**. These values should provide a smoother output while preserving the necessary detail for our tracking algorithms.

Please apply these parameters to the configuration file on all relevant units and let me know if you observe any unexpected behavior during the next test run.
